summary.headline: Equinoxes and Solstice
summary.text: Discussion of the celestial circles and their intersections, identifying the vernal equinox or point of Aries and the autumnal equinox or first degree of Libra. It then explains the summer solstice at the beginning of Cancer and the meanings of northern, increasing, and ascending declination, with reference to Theodosius’s Spherics and Polaris.
